snippet.title: Virtua Fighter 5 R.E.V.O | Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Step in the ring and get 20% Off for a Limited Time - VF5 R.E.V.O. is out now on Steam!

Virtua Fighter 5 R.E.V.O takes Virtua Fighter 5 Ultimate Showdown to the next level! Featuring Rollback Netcode —experience smoother and more in-depth battles with opponents from all over the world, 4K resolution support @ 60FPS,  a ton of balance adjustments, all-new moves, combos and more!

Available in standard and the 30th Anniversary Edition featuring exclusive costumes, soundtracks, artwork, rank titles, and extra content packs– both available on Steam at 20% off for a limited time.

Steam Store: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3112260/Virtua_Fighter_5_REVO/

Follow us on X: @VF_SEGA
Visit our Official Website: Virtua Fighter 5 R.E.V.O.
Join our Official Discord Server: Join Discord and connect with other players and get the latest Virtua Fighter news!
